metadata.scenario: A prospect calls to inquire about the range of skincare services offered. Category: New Inquiry. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, my name is Agnes Rodriguez. I’m looking for information on your skincare services. Hi Agnes, it's great to hear from you! We don’t specifically offer skincare services, but we do provide personal care assistance which includes help with skin health. Oh, I see. What exactly does personal care assistance include? Personal care assistance includes help with bathing, dressing, grooming, and general hygiene. That sounds helpful, especially for my mom. Absolutely! We can also help remind clients to use their skincare products if needed. That would be great. Does that include specialized care for elderly skin? Yes, our caregivers are trained to handle the unique needs of elderly skin, including moisturizing and wound care. That’s good to know. How often can these services be scheduled? Our services can be scheduled based on your mom's needs—daily, weekly, or as needed. What’s the cost for personal care assistance? The price ranges from $28 to $35 per hour, depending on the level of care required. That fits within our budget. What’s the process to get started? First, I'd recommend a care plan consultation. I can schedule you with our Care Coordinator, Lisa Chen. That sounds perfect. Can you provide me with her contact information? Sure! Lisa's direct number is +13165559203. You can reach her Monday through Saturday. Great! I’ll call her to discuss setting something up. If you prefer, I can also have her call you to follow up. Yes, that would be very helpful. Perfect! I’ll pass on your details for Lisa to reach out. Thank you so much, Margaret. I really appreciate your help! You’re very welcome, Agnes! Is there anything else I can assist you with? No, that’s all for now. Thanks again! Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health. Have a great day!
